video_title: The Secret To Boosting Your VO2 Max
evidence: SponsorRadar's current The Running Channel sponsorship page lists 'The Secret To Boosting Your VO2 Max' as sponsored by Science In Sport on July 30, 2026. Science In Sport sells physical sports nutrition products and its official customer-care/help pages explicitly route sponsorship inquiries to sponsorship@scienceinsport.com; the brand also operates its current Team SiS creator collaboration program. The GitHub repository was rechecked immediately before staging and surfaced no Science In Sport or scienceinsport.com match.
